description.text: Introduction The world economy, or global economy, generally refers to the economy, which is based on economies of all of the world's countries' national economies. Global Economics majors study economics in the context of a particular geographic area, incorporating language study, area study, and study abroad into their academic plan. Teaching Objectives Students who complete the program will develop a sound understanding of economics in an international context, focusing particularly on one geographic area. The program also increases the educational opportunities of graduates to develop critical thinking skills and gain experiential learning opportunities in the area of international economics. Internship Students will have the opportunities to be engaged in industrial collaborative projects, interview techniques, resume instructions and review, visits to companies, and career consultation. Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted Master Degree of Economics in World Economy by Central China Normal University. Future Career Employment opportunities for well-trained graduates in Global Economics are excellent in government, international trade and finance, and industry.

duration.text: The World Economics at Central China Normal University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3888 USD/per year ￥ 28000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 2.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 3.Undergraduate school transcript 4.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5.English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 6.Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: graduate student with a good command of English
